lifecycles._note: Secret Vault CRUD covering POST /v1/secretvault (create vault), GET /v1/secretvault/{id} (show), and PUT /v1/secretvault/{id}/terminated (terminate). KEY FINDING (2026-06-23 live-validated): access_key_id in the create body MUST be the IAM access key UUID 'id' field (from GET /v1/access-keys $.access_keys[0].id), NOT the access_key string value and NOT SCP_ACCESS_KEY. The pre-step fetch-iam-key-id fetches this UUID. Constraint: 1 auth key can only bind to 1 Secret Vault at a time — if a vault already exists for the key, create 400s ('Access key is already in use.') and capture_soft yields None (graceful). name MUST match ^[a-z0-9]*$ len 3-63; temporary_key_ttl_nhours in [1,36]; vault_token_ttl_ndays in [30,7300]; acl_cidr is CIDR string. Terminate: waiting_time_ndays in [7,30] — the ONLY deletion path (no hard DELETE). gettemporarykey PERMANENT blocker: needs vault-issued Svaccesskey/Svsignature/Svtimestamp/Svclienttype headers not derivable from SCP creds. Chain: fetch-iam-key-id(GET,capture) -> list(GET) -> create(POST,capture) -> show(GET) -> get-temporarykey(GET,expected-400) -> terminate(PUT).

steps.name: fetch-iam-key-id
steps._note: Pre-step: fetch caller's IAM access key UUID (id field) from GET /v1/access-keys. Secret Vault create body access_key_id MUST be this UUID, NOT the access_key string/SCP_ACCESS_KEY value. Captures $.access_keys[0].id as iam_key_id. LIVE-VALIDATED 2026-06-23: key id=e8363ebf17c6474f9d036a3c287aa167.

steps.name: list-secretvaults
steps._note: List all secret vaults (GET /v1/secretvault, listsecretvault). Real envelope: {count, page, secret_vaults[], size, sort}. capture_soft grabs first vault id for probe-reads. Live-verified 200 2026-06-20.

steps.name: create
steps._note: Create secret vault. CRITICAL: access_key_id = IAM access key UUID (id from fetch-iam-key-id). NOT the access_key string. 201 on success; 400 'Access key is already in use.' when same auth key already bound (only 1 vault per key). capture_soft so downstream steps gracefully skip on 4xx. LIVE-VALIDATED 2026-06-23 201.

steps.name: get-secretvault
steps._note: id-bound read (showsecretvault). Keys off create-captured or list-captured secret_vault_id. LIVE-VALIDATED 2026-06-23 200 with real vault id. Closes GET /v1/secretvault/{secret_vault_id}.

steps.name: get-temporarykey
steps._note: PERMANENT BLOCKER: gettemporarykey requires vault-issued auth headers Svaccesskey/Svsignature/Svtimestamp/Svclienttype not derivable from SCP API credentials. Live-confirmed 400 'Svaccesskey is not existed.' even with real vault id. Cannot be covered without vault-token injection. Kept so endpoint is exercised (statically reachable).

steps.name: terminate
steps._note: Terminate secret vault (terminatedsecretvault). ONLY deletion path — no hard DELETE. waiting_time_ndays in [7,30]. 200 on success; 404 when no vault created this run (placeholder id). LIVE-VALIDATED 2026-06-23 200.
